text:
maria: Heads-up 2070: planning a 35m webinar: 'Inference costs that scale'  need final abstracts, reg copy, panel list, and a rehearsed failover. Deadline for drafts: Mon noon PT.

devon: I'll own cost + perf snapshot. Will make a tiny visual: p50/p95 + cost per 1k for two common configs.

sam: I'll write the product-demo blurb. Thinking ~7m live API integration + 3m prerecorded deep-dive for fallback.

eric: Live + prerec fallback works. For the fallback I want an SRE trigger that reroutes requests to the cold-quantized variant. Can eng-oncall help script that?

eng-oncall: Yep. We can provide a safe toggle on staging and add a smoke-check to validate responses. Need exact URL and auth token pattern.

maria: For registration copy: keep 2 sentences + 3 bullets (what you'll learn). Design prefers a headline + 1-line subhead. Jules-design, can you mock two variants?

jules-design: Can do. I'll post two hero images and two short headline options by Tue AM. Prefer short calls-to-action: 'Register' and 'See benchmarks'.

aya: I'll coordinate panel invites. Proposed panel: 1 customer who uses Dedicated, 1 partner (inference infra), and an internal product lead. I'll confirm availability by Mon EOD.

kendra: On routing: I'll set up these buckets: "trial-ready", "researcher", "enterprise-opps". Registration fields we need: job_title, company_domain, estimated_users. Will map rules after we lock the form.

salesops: FYI, prefer "trial-ready" to include 'requests demo' or 'signup intent' flag so Sales can triage. Webhook payload should include lead_score and tag.

devon: For the benchmark blurb I'll keep it snappy: two line copy + a single chart. Example line: "See p95 and token-cost tradeoffs across quantized and full precision models."

sam: Draft demo copy: "Live integration: Redwood API + prefix caching. We'll show real app latency and a playback of how batching reduces cost." Thoughts?

maria: Good. Add one sentence noting the rollback path we'll demo (automated fallback to cheaper model + cached KV serving). Keep it plain language for marketing.

eric: Runbook for failover rehearsal: 1) Start in primary route; 2) Run curl to flip route; 3) Validate sample prompt returns expected fallback model. I'll paste the curl after I grab staging endpoint.

eng-oncall: We'll also add a tiny health-check script that hits a known prompt and checks token latency <500ms. If failure, alert channel. That can run before the demo.

jules-design: Quick Q: do we need a slide template for the benchmark? I can make a 1-slide visual with the chart and 3 bullets.

devon: Yes please. CSV + chart specs coming. I'll include labels: model, p50, p95, cost/1k, throughput@batch32.

kendra: Routing dry-run plan: once reg form is up, I'll run 50 test signups with staged domains and post results in #marketing-ops. Will confirm webhook delivery to SalesOps staging endpoint.

maria: Moderator: we propose Kendra as moderator and Aya to lead the panel. Can you both confirm?

kendra: Happy to moderate.

aya: I can lead the panel. Will prep 4 questions focused on reliability, cost, and integration effort.

salesops: Please make sure the webhook includes speaker_opt_in boolean so we can send followups.

eric: Staging one-liner to flip route (example): `curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.internal/v1/routes/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" -d '{"target":"quantized-backup"}'` — I'll provide the final token param in the runbook.

maria: Rehearsal window Wed 9:00-9:30am PT. We'll do a full run + failover at 9:12. Everyone listed above please RSVP.

devon: Can we also include a short Q/A prep doc so panelists have suggested answers? I'll draft two bullets per question.

jules-design: Working on social card copy variations. Short variant: "Cut inference spend without sacrificing latency" Long variant: two lines + CTA.

maria: Reminder: landing page needs 1 customer quote (one sentence). Aya, can you secure that in time? If not, we'll use anonymized metric quote.

aya: I have a permission form I can send. Will aim for a quote like: "Redwood cut our inference costs by 35% while keeping p95 stable."

kendra: After webinar, routing rule: anyone marked trial-ready + opened followup email gets added to SalesOps queue with priority=high. I'll automate that in the flow.

maria: Final owners recap: Benchmarks/devon, Demo/sam+eric, Design/jules-design, Panel Aya, Routing/kendra, Moderator/kendra, Rehearsal slots/eng-oncall.

maria: Please post final abstracts and the registration copy in this thread by Mon noon PT. I will do a final pass and send to comms/design.

sam: Will post demo abstract Monday morning.

devon: Benchmark draft will be up by Mon 11am.

eric: I'll drop the staging toggle command + runbook Monday after lunch.

eng-oncall: We'll prep health-check script and confirm maintenance window.

maria: Thanks all. If anything is blocked, flag here and we'll escalate.
